subject.title: fix(browser): stop screenshot vision-failure fallback from injecting raw base64

question: Do browser owners approve Option A: when a configured screenshot vision model fails, return only the failure/share text rather than preserving a model-visible screenshot fallback?
rationale: This is a deliberate compatibility and recovery-policy change for existing configured-vision users; the supplied selection is from the external contributor, while the prior review specifically required owner approval.

options.title: Approve text-only recovery
options.body: Adopt the branch behavior: prevent session image contamination and require explicit message-tool sharing after configured vision failures.

options.title: Design transient image recovery
options.body: Keep a degraded model-visible screenshot path only through a new delivery mechanism proven not to persist image data in recent session turns.

recommendation.title: Approve text-only recovery
recommendation.body: Adopt the branch behavior: prevent session image contamination and require explicit message-tool sharing after configured vision failures.

likelyOwner.reason: No current-main history or explicit browser owner is present in the supplied review context, but the choice belongs with the browser behavior owner rather than the contributor.
